name: Non-Product Output Readout Dichotomy
description: Theorem: if OZ is not a Cartesian product and RZ is properly aligned projective, then either SZ = OZ with RZ = ID(SZ), or OZ = S1Z with RZ = PJN(SZ, 1).

elements.text: In the first-factor branch, OZ(O1Z) = FSZ(S1Z).
Aligned single-output readout returning the state tuple (SZ = OZ, RZ = ID(SZ) when m = 1).
Bundled readout RZ = PJN(SZ, S1Z) when OZ = S1Z.
Either SZ = OZ and RZ = ID(SZ), or OZ = S1Z and RZ = PJN(SZ, 1).
